note: Anderson Point, on a wooded point of Anglin Lake within Great Blue Heron Provincial Park, ~60 km N of Prince Albert off Hwy 953; separate from the Emma Lake (Murray Point) campgrounds. There is no campground office at Anglin Lake: buy the vehicle entry permit online before arriving. --Claude
